description: This is the main entry point of a Flutter mobile application called 'Audio Boost Pro'. It sets up dependencies via Provider, initializes application state and services, and manages app lifecycle including bootstrapping, loading, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets up providers and the main MaterialApp.

classes.name: AppBootstrapper
classes.description: Stateful widget responsible for app startup sequence, including loading settings and audio services.

classes.name: _AppBootstrapperState
classes.description: State object for AppBootstrapper, manages initialization, booting, and error handling.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: Main shell widget with bottom navigation to switch between app pages.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: State object for AppShell, manages page navigation and UI updates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Configured widget tree for each widget, responsible for rendering UI.

methods.name: _boot
methods.description: Performs app initialization tasks asynchronously, loads settings and audio, and handles errors.
